title: Corner Signup Flow: Technical Spec
summary: Builder brief for Bobby on the Corner signup + onboarding flow. Auth to first message in under 3 minutes. Industry-specific auto-build. Copy strings, routes, API calls, state, animations.
content:
Corner Signup Flow: Technical Spec

For: Bobby (implementation) Owner: Steve (Sales Director) Date: 2026-03-22 Priority: P1 -- ship after S1-S3 are closed, before first paid customer

Overview

The signup flow is a 5-screen wizard that takes a visitor from "I want in" to "I'm talking to my AI team" in under 3 minutes. It must feel fast, personal, and magical -- not like filling out a form.

Current state: 5-step wizard exists (Welcome > Name workspace > Place first room > Done). That skeleton stays. We're replacing the content and adding the auto-build logic.

Success criteria: A construction company owner signs up, sees "Follow up with Johnson Electric re: Tuesday estimate" in their task list, and believes Corner was built for them.

Routes

Route Status Action
/signup New Email + password signup form
/onboarding Exists (404s in prod) Fix vercel.json -- add this route
/onboarding/business New Screen 2: What do you do?
/onboarding/pain New Screen 3: What's eating your time?
/onboarding/team New Screen 4: Meet your team
/onboarding/go New Screen 5: Let's get to work
/dashboard Exists Final destination after onboarding

Add all /onboarding/* routes to vercel.json under rewrites. All route to the same index.html. React Router handles the sub-routes client-side.

State Shape

// OnboardingContext -- persists across screens via sessionStorage
{
  workspaceName: string,        // "Johnson Electric"
  industry: string,             // "construction-electrical"
  industryDisplay: string,      // "Electrical Contractor"
  pains: string[],              // ["scheduling", "follow-up", "invoicing"]
  agentRoster: Agent[],         // auto-built from industry + pains
  sampleTasks: Task[],          // auto-built from industry
  userId: string,               // from Supabase auth
  clientId: string,             // from Supabase user metadata
}

Screen 1: What's your business called? (/onboarding)

Layout: Full screen, centered. No nav.

Copy:

[Progress: 1/5]

What's your business called?

[___________________________]  <- large text input, autofocus

Continue ->

Behavior:

  • As the user types (debounce 300ms), the isometric office renders in the background with their name on the building sign.
  • Use existing GameCanvas component with read-only mode. Pass workspaceName as prop.
  • "Continue" button is disabled until input has >= 2 chars.
  • On continue: save workspaceName to OnboardingContext. Navigate to /onboarding/business.

Animation: Office fades in from opacity 0 to 0.6 (blurred, behind the form) as they type.

Screen 2: What do you do? (/onboarding/business)

Layout: Full screen, centered. Back button top-left.

Copy:

[Progress: 2/5]

What does [workspaceName] do?

[Construction]       [CPA / Accounting]
[Agency / Consulting]  [Restaurant / Hospitality]
[Real Estate]        [Other]

Behavior:

  • Single-select grid of cards. Each card has an icon + label.
  • If "Construction" is selected, show a sub-selector (2nd row appears):
  [HVAC]  [Plumbing]  [Electrical]  [General Contractor]  [Roofing]  [Other]
  • "Continue" is disabled until an industry (and sub-type if construction) is selected.
  • On continue: save industry + industryDisplay to context. Navigate to /onboarding/pain.

Industry -> industry key mapping:

const INDUSTRY_KEYS = {
  'HVAC': 'construction-hvac',
  'Plumbing': 'construction-plumbing',
  'Electrical': 'construction-electrical',
  'General Contractor': 'construction-gc',
  'Roofing': 'construction-roofing',
  'CPA / Accounting': 'cpa',
  'Agency / Consulting': 'agency',
  'Restaurant / Hospitality': 'restaurant',
  'Real Estate': 'real-estate',
  'Other': 'other',
}

Screen 3: What's eating your time? (/onboarding/pain)

Layout: Full screen, centered. Back button top-left.

Copy:

[Progress: 3/5]

What's eating your time at [workspaceName]?
Pick up to 3.

[Scheduling]         [Client follow-up]
[Estimating]         [Invoicing]
[Content / Social]   [Lead generation]
[Admin / Paperwork]  [Employee management]

Continue ->

Behavior:

  • Multi-select. Max 3. Already-selected cards get a checkmark. On 4th tap, nothing happens (visual shake on the 4th selection).
  • "Continue" is disabled until at least 1 is selected.
  • On continue: save pains array to context. Call buildAgentRoster(industry, pains) and buildSampleTasks(industry). Save results to context. Navigate to /onboarding/team.

Auto-Build Logic (buildAgentRoster + buildSampleTasks)

Agent Roster

const AGENT_CONFIGS = {
  // All industries get a router + QA by default
  default: [
    { slug: 'elon', name: 'Max', role: 'Operations Coordinator', intro: "I keep your team organized and route work to the right agent." },
    { slug: 'elmo', name: 'Quinn', role: 'Quality Control', intro: "I review everything before it reaches you. Nothing ships without my sign-off." },
  ],

  // Pain-mapped agents
  scheduling: {
    slug: 'scheduler', name: 'Cal', role: 'Scheduler', intro: "I own your calendar. No double-books, no missed appointments."
  },
  'client follow-up': {
    slug: 'followup', name: 'Faye', role: 'Follow-Up Manager', intro: "I make sure no lead or client falls through the cracks."
  },
  estimating: {
    slug: 'estimator', name: 'Rex', role: 'Estimating Support', intro: "I pull together bid details so you can send proposals faster."
  },
  invoicing: {
    slug: 'invoicer', name: 'Finn', role: 'Billing & Invoicing', intro: "I draft invoices, track overdue accounts, and follow up on payments."
  },
  'content / social': {
    slug: 'content', name: 'Cleo', role: 'Content Creator', intro: "I handle your social posts, captions, and online presence."
  },
  'lead generation': {
    slug: 'outreach', name: 'Jake', role: 'Outreach Manager', intro: "I find leads and run outreach so your pipeline stays full."
  },
  'admin / paperwork': {
    slug: 'admin', name: 'Dot', role: 'Admin Manager', intro: "I handle the back-office stuff so you don't have to."
  },
  'employee management': {
    slug: 'hr', name: 'Vera', role: 'Team Coordinator', intro: "I track assignments, manage schedules, and keep your team aligned."
  },
}

function buildAgentRoster(industry, pains) {
  const roster = [...AGENT_CONFIGS.default]
  pains.forEach(pain => {
    if (AGENT_CONFIGS[pain]) roster.push(AGENT_CONFIGS[pain])
  })
  // Cap at 6 agents for clean UI
  return roster.slice(0, 6)
}

Screen 4: Meet your team (/onboarding/team)

Layout: Full screen. Office renders full-width in background. Agent cards in foreground.

Copy:

[Progress: 4/5]

Meet your team, [workspaceName].

[Agent card 1]  [Agent card 2]  [Agent card 3]
[Agent card 4]  [Agent card 5]  [Agent card 6]

They're ready. ->

Agent card:

[Agent avatar / pixel art icon]
[Name]
[Role]
"[Intro line]"    <- typewriter animation, 1 agent at a time

Behavior:

  • Agents appear one at a time, 800ms between each. Their intro text typewriters in.
  • After all agents have appeared, "They're ready." button fades in.
  • On continue: navigate to /onboarding/go.

Design note for Steffen: Use existing pixel art character assets. Map each agent slug to a character. Create 1 default character for any unmapped slug. Warm day-mode background. This screen is the emotional peak -- make it feel alive.

Screen 5: Let's get to work (/onboarding/go)

Layout: Mostly game viewport (existing GameCanvas). Task panel visible on the right.

Copy:

[Progress: 5/5]

Your office is live.

[Full game view with 3-4 rooms visible]
[Task list on right with 3-4 sample tasks, first one shows "In Progress"]

[Agent chat at bottom]
"Welcome to [workspaceName]. I'm Max, your operations coordinator. Your team is already working.
Here's the status: [sample task 1 -- IN PROGRESS], [sample task 2 -- QUEUED], [sample task 3 -- QUEUED].
What would you like me to focus on first?"

[Type a message to your team...]

Behavior:

  • On mount: write the auto-built agents + sample tasks to Supabase via:
    • POST /api/onboarding/complete with { clientId, workspaceName, agents, tasks }
    • This upserts agents to agent_status table and inserts tasks to tasks table
    • Marks onboarding_complete: true on the user's Supabase record
  • The router agent's welcome message appears via typewriter animation (1 second delay after mount).
  • Chat input is focused. User types a message. Agent responds via the existing relay pipeline.
  • After the user sends their first message: show a toast "You're in. Welcome to Corner." + confetti burst.
  • The onboarding is done. No explicit "Finish" button. Being in the conversation IS the finish.

On subsequent sessions: If onboarding_complete: true on the user record, skip all onboarding screens. Land directly on /dashboard.

API: /api/onboarding/complete

// POST /api/onboarding/complete
// Body: { clientId, workspaceName, agents, tasks }

// 1. Upsert workspace name to clients table
await supabase
  .from('clients')
  .upsert({ id: clientId, name: workspaceName }, { onConflict: 'id' })

// 2. Upsert agents to agent_status table
for (const agent of agents) {
  await supabase
    .from('agent_status')
    .upsert({
      client_id: clientId,
      agent: agent.slug,
      display_name: agent.name,
      role: agent.role,
      status: 'idle',
    }, { onConflict: 'agent,client_id' })
}

// 3. Insert sample tasks
for (const task of tasks) {
  await supabase
    .from('tasks')
    .insert({
      client_id: clientId,
      agent: 'elon',
      project: 'internal',
      description: task,
      status: 'right-now',
    })
}

// 4. Mark onboarding complete
await supabase.auth.updateUser({
  data: { onboarding_complete: true }
})

What Stays

  • Existing Supabase auth (email/password)
  • Existing AuthGuard redirect to /onboarding
  • Existing GameCanvas component (used in screens 1 and 5)
  • Existing task management + agent chat (just pre-populated)

What Changes

  • Remove sessionStorage.setItem('dash-auth','1') bypass (S1)
  • Add /onboarding/* routes to vercel.json (S2)
  • Replace DEFAULT_PROJECTS hardcode with Supabase lookup (S3)
  • Build the 5-screen wizard using OnboardingContext (this spec)
  • Add /api/onboarding/complete endpoint

Timeline

Week 1 (pre-outreach gates): S1, S2, S3 only. The wizard can wait. No real prospect clicks through signup until Patrik texts them.

Week 2 (before first demo converts): S4 (new /corner copy) + S5 (chat fix) + basic wizard (screens 1 and 2 minimum, rest can be defaults).

Week 3 (before referral wave): Full wizard (screens 1-5) with auto-build logic. This is when self-service becomes possible and word-of-mouth referrals need to land themselves.

Quality Bar

Before this ships to a real prospect:

  1. Name input -> office updates with business name. No lag.
  2. Industry selector -> sub-type works cleanly.
  3. Pain selector -> max 3 enforced, shake on 4th.
  4. Agent cards -> typewriter animations don't race or overlap.
  5. Sample tasks in dashboard -> reference the right industry (no KOHRS, no LBX, no AOM client names).
  6. Router agent welcome message -> contains the prospect's actual workspace name.
  7. First chat message -> gets a real response (relay pipeline live on prod).

Elmo QAs all 7 before any prospect touches it.
